twineedle.name: Twineedle
twineedle.effect: Hits twice in the same turn.  Has a chance to poison the target.

twister.name: Twister
twister.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

u-turn.name: U-turn
u-turn.effect: User must switch out after attacking.

upper-hand.name: Upper Hand
upper-hand.effect: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

uproar.name: Uproar
uproar.effect: Forced to use this move for several turns.  Pokémon cannot fall asleep in that time.

v-create.name: V-create
v-create.effect: Lowers the user’s Defense, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.

vacuum-wave.name: Vacuum Wave
vacuum-wave.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

venom-drench.name: Venom Drench
venom-drench.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by one stage if it is poisoned.

venoshock.name: Venoshock
venoshock.effect: Inflicts double damage if the target is Poisoned.

vice-grip.name: Vise Grip
vice-grip.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

victory-dance.name: Victory Dance
victory-dance.effect: The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, boosting its Attack, Defense, and Speed stats.

vine-whip.name: Vine Whip
vine-whip.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

volt-switch.name: Volt Switch
volt-switch.effect: User must switch out after attacking.

volt-tackle.name: Volt Tackle
volt-tackle.effect: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.  Has a chance to paralyze the target.

wake-up-slap.name: Wake-Up Slap
wake-up-slap.effect: If the target is asleep, has double power and wakes it up.

water-gun.name: Water Gun
water-gun.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

water-pledge.name: Water Pledge
water-pledge.effect: With Grass Pledge, halves opposing Pokémon’s Speed for four turns.

water-pulse.name: Water Pulse
water-pulse.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.

water-spout.name: Water Spout
water-spout.effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.

waterfall.name: Waterfall
waterfall.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

wave-crash.name: Wave Crash
wave-crash.effect: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.

weather-ball.name: Weather Ball
weather-ball.effect: If there be weather, this move has doubled power and the weather’s type.

whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
whirlpool.effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle and inflicts 1/16 its max HP in damage for 2-5 turns.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.effect: Immediately ends wild battles.  Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.

wide-guard.name: Wide Guard
wide-guard.effect: Prevents any multi-target moves from hitting friendly Pokémon this turn.

wild-charge.name: Wild Charge
wild-charge.effect: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

wildbolt-storm.name: Wildbolt Storm
wildbolt-storm.effect: The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely attacks with lightning and wind. This may also leave opposing Pokémon with paralysis.

wing-attack.name: Wing Attack
wing-attack.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

wish.name: Wish
wish.effect: User will recover half its max HP at the end of the next turn.

withdraw.name: Withdraw
withdraw.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.

wonder-room.name: Wonder Room
wonder-room.effect: All Pokémon’s Defense and Special Defense are swapped for 5 turns.

wood-hammer.name: Wood Hammer
wood-hammer.effect: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.

work-up.name: Work Up
work-up.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.

worry-seed.name: Worry Seed
worry-seed.effect: Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia.

wrap.name: Wrap
wrap.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.

wring-out.name: Wring Out
wring-out.effect: Power increases against targets with more HP remaining, up to a maximum of 121 power.

x-scissor.name: X-Scissor
x-scissor.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

yawn.name: Yawn
yawn.effect: Target sleeps at the end of the next turn.

zap-cannon.name: Zap Cannon
zap-cannon.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

zen-headbutt.name: Zen Headbutt
zen-headbutt.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

zing-zap.name: Zing Zap
zing-zap.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
